visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair, wearing a horizontal-striped white and navy t-shirt, is in a bright kitchen. He is hunched over a wooden countertop, using a utility knife to cut the top off a silver beer can. He sniffs the interior of two open cans and gestures towards the kitchen area. (2) The man moves around the kitchen, placing the open beer cans in low, dark spots: under the sink cabinets, behind an oven on a wooden floor, and near table legs on a tiled floor. He squats down to look directly into the camera, explaining the process with animated facial expressions. (3) He opens a white lower kitchen cabinet, pointing inside at a metal dish rack where a small cockroach is briefly visible. He places a beer can trap inside the cabinet. (4) The scene transitions to the next day; the man uses a knife to peel back the cut top of the beer can. The camera zooms in to a blurred interior shot showing dark shapes representing caught insects. He reacts with a mix of disgust and amusement, standing up and laughing near a white kitchen counter. (5) The man holds up an orange and white box of 'Combat' (快點絕) cockroach bait. He puts on a white glove and applies small dots of brown gel from a syringe onto the wooden floor and cabinet corners. (6) Macro shots show several small dead cockroaches near the gel bait on the floor and in the cabinets. The man uses a broom to sweep the area and then picks up the gel with a tissue, finally leaning on his broom and laughing at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Harsh metallic scraping and clicking sounds open the track as the man cuts the can. This is immediately followed by a loud, high-pitched synthetic cartoon scream. (2) An upbeat acoustic guitar and drum rhythm starts as the BGM. The male speaker enters with a bright, high-arousal tone, speaking rapidly about catching cockroaches with beer. The BGM remains at a consistent level under his voice. (3) A sudden 'whoosh' transition leads to a found-object scraping sound. As the trap is revealed, a chorus of high-pitched cartoon screams and a sharp 'ding' sound effect emphasize the catch. The man laughs mockingly with high vocal variability. (4) The BGM continues as the man introduces the product. The sound of the plastic box being handled is audible. His voice remains clear and persuasive. (5) Soft swishing sounds of the gel being applied to wood are heard. A 'pling' digital SFX accompanies the macro reveals of dead roaches. (6) The sound of stiff broom bristles sweeping against a wooden floor is prominent. The man concludes with a loud, triumphant laugh and mocking comments about the old beer can method, while the BGM fades out with a final chord.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> DIY Solution failure -> Professional Solution -> Proof -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comedic product endorsement for BASF 'Combat' (快點絕) cockroach gel bait. It uses a 'before and after' comparison strategy, first showing a messy and slow DIY beer-can method to grab attention, then demonstrating the superior efficiency and cleanliness of the advertised gel bait through visual proof of dead roaches.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, application tutorial, and verbal recommendation of the brand name.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes social-media-native editing with high text density and cartoon SFX to maintain engagement. The juxtaposition of a gross DIY method with a clean professional solution effectively highlights the product's value proposition.
